review_candidates.title: Senior Network Engineer

remote_eligibility.note: Generic company words such as 'worldwide' do not count without remote-work context.

review_candidates.description_excerpt: Job Summary: The Senior Network Engineer is responsible for delivering high-quality technical activities, including solution implementation, integration, troubleshooting, proof of concept (POC) development, and presentations. Key Responsibilities: Respond to and resolve incidents and service requests via the service management system and other channels (email and phone) within predefined service level agreements (SLA). Provide general IT infrastructure support during high workload periods or staffing shortages. Represent the infrastructure team in meetings and communications with staff, vendors, and third parties as required.
review_candidates.full_review_rule: Open the full record for any possible IT fit or any ambiguity; title alone cannot reject.
